answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the vault binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The pearl explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Splitting into 9 separate vaults requires a separate funded pulse account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 483 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
